# R5.46 — Bounded activation + fixed N=10 pilot evidence (GATE-G12, both readings)

Implements `docs/tickets/221_R5.46__pilot.md` (seq 221 of 246) —
collect bounded activation evidence, then the operator-authorized
fixed pilot. Two executed packets, both honest dispositions:

- **`hh-activation/1`** — `docs/build/reports/2026-11-04-r5.46-activation-podman.json`:
  `disposition=executed`, 7/7 legs verified. One task's two first
  subjects (`a-hello`, `subject_arm_a`=`evict_oldest` /
  `subject_arm_b`=`clear_tool_results`, `search_budget=0`) on real
  podman cells; the frozen set bound before any data
  (`freeze_id=0be644f7…` minted inside the record); real `compact()`
  ladders under eligible pressure opportunities; §4.2 denominators
  2/2/2/2 + 2/2 triggered; all-first/all-attempt costs; declared §9.2
  worksheet; `pilot=withheld{reading_2_pending}` — never executed
  under Reading 1.
- **`hh-pilot/1`** — `docs/build/reports/2026-11-04-r5.46-pilot-podman.json`:
  `disposition=executed`, 17/17 legs verified. GATE-G12 **Reading 2
  PASSED** (operator verbatim "passed, I confirm/authorize. proceed
  autonomously without interruption", 2026-11-04T05:44:42Z, after the
  operator reviewed the activation result) authorized the fixed pilot
  at the declared **N=10 floor** (2·T·R≥10T at T=1, R=5; ≤60 ceiling
  respected). 2·T·R=10 first subjects — 5 replicates per fixed arm —
  on real podman cells (`executor_backend=container`, zero setup
  retries, 20/20 dispatches `observed:applied`, USD $0.00). The pilot
  freeze carries the **same members** as the activation freeze under
  `phase=pilot` and honors `activation_freeze_id=0be644f7…` verbatim
  (read back from the committed packet, verified — never re-declared);
  `freeze_id=ba0ca403…` minted before data. §4.2 denominators
  10/10/10/10 + 10/10 triggered; §3.2 missingness bound
  [s/M,(s+u)/M]=[10/10,10/10]; nearest-rank P50/P95/max wall + tokens
  spread per arm (a: 1279/1825/1825ms, 442..442; b: 1213/1763/1763ms,
  592..592), censoring retained; §9.2-envelope feasibility (all
  measured maxima inside ≤100 calls / 1M·100k tokens / 30min / ≤2
  concurrent / ≤1 retry); all-first/all-attempt costs; worksheet
  `gate_pending:GATE-G12` echoed — Reading 2 is a recorded fact, never
  inferred. `contrast_claimed=false`, `tuning_performed=false` — a
  pilot cannot become confirmation; nothing here claims parity,
  confirmation or a scientific effect.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-env/src/activation.rs` (+495, landed at `77e341b8`) —
  the `hh-activation/1` record: closed 7-leg vocabulary, records-in
  evaluators (`evaluate_freeze`/`evaluate_arm`/`evaluate_fidelity`/
  `evaluate_costs`/`evaluate_pilot_withheld`), `freeze_id` before
  data, `packet_id` last, `executed|failed|inconclusive` fold.
- `crates/hh-env/src/pilot.rs` (+632, new) — the `hh-pilot/1` record:
  closed 17-leg vocabulary (`freeze`, ten `subject_{a,b}_r{1..5}`,
  `fidelity`, `variance_tail`, `missingness`, `feasibility`, `costs`,
  `worksheet`); `PilotFreezeFacts`/`evaluate_pilot_freeze` (same
  members + `phase=pilot`, T/R/declared checks, floor/ceiling,
  `reading_2=passed`, 64-hex `activation_freeze_id` verified);
  `PilotSubject`/`evaluate_pilot_subject` (reused `ArmOutcome` +
  `evaluate_arm` plus the §3.1 outcome-class check);
  `evaluate_pilot_fidelity` (all_first=10); `evaluate_missingness`
  (planned-reconciled `[s/M,(s+u)/M]` ppm bound, unplanned=0);
  `evaluate_variance_tail` (ordered nearest-rank percentiles +
  censoring + sign counts; `contrast_claimed`/`tuning_performed`
  refused); `evaluate_feasibility` (every §9.2 envelope member;
  `cells_attempted==0` → honest `inconclusive{backend_unavailable}`);
  `assemble_pilot` (vocabulary/unique/complete; `freeze_id` before
  data; `packet_id` last; definitive-dominates-undetermined fold).
- `crates/hh-env/tests/r5_46.rs` (1320→2197) — the drive generalized:
  `drive_arm` → `drive_cell` returning `(ArmOutcome, CellExtras)`
  (real wall_ms, dispatch calls, plan occupancy, produced output
  bytes, artifact flag — the activation callers and outcomes
  unchanged); `LIVE_LOCK` serializes live cells (the `hh-env-*`
  sweep would destroy a parallel leg's container);
  `worksheet_decl(pilot_dispatch)` parameterized (activation packet
  admits activation dispatch; pilot packet admits pilot dispatch —
  `gate_pending:GATE-G12` echoed). New legs: `run_pilot` (10 real
  podman cells, 5/arm, ≤1 setup retry each), `pilot_freeze_facts`
  (the honored `freeze_id` parsed back from the committed
  `hh-activation/1` record — `Json::parse`, not re-typed), and the
  `pilot*` battery below.
